method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (oas-core.l4, with six regulative rules) and a seat layer (oas-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a person outside the encoding answers an explicit value, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Old Age Security Act, R.S.C., 1985, c. O-9, and Old Age Security Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1246, Justice Laws consolidation current to 2026-09-30 (Act last amended 2025-10-01; Regulations 2026-06-12), from justicecanada/laws-lois-xml commit 0507465393c224c0491fc8c17c88340217acc656, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/R.S.C.-1985-c.-O-9.txt and C.R.C.-c.-1246.txt. The quarterly CPI-indexed amounts are not deposited and are inputs.

checks.command: l4 run oas-core.l4 ; l4 run oas-seat.l4 ; l4 run oas-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 72 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 5 #TRACEs with an expect line (3 breaches by the applicant, 2 obligations pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the person applying for or receiving OAS: s 2 (income for months after June 2020, special qualifying factor, survivor), s 2.1, s 3(1)(b)-(c), (2)-(4), s 4(1), s 7(5), s 7.1, s 9(1)-(4), s 11(7)(b)-(e), s 12(5)-(6), s 12.1(1)-(2), s 19(1)-(2), (6)(b)-(d), s 21(1)-(2), (9)(b)-(c), s 21.1(1), s 22(1)-(4), (6), s 22.1; Regulations ss 6, 7, 8(2), 21(1), 25(1), 26.1; duties under s 14(1), s 15(9), s 27.1, s 37(1), s 9.3 as regulative rules. Out: s 3(1)(a), social security agreements, commencement and retroactivity, waivers of application, s 14(2)-(7), pre-July-2020 income, s 12(5.1), incarceration, the OAS recovery tax (ITA Part I.2), recovery machinery, agreements, offences, appeals. Read with subjects/ca/income-tax-act/ (income under the ITA and the recovery tax); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the individual applying for or receiving an Old Age Security pension, supplement or allowance
